title: No. 5 Miami is showing off its depth on offense after 2 blowout wins to open the season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: No. 5 Miami is showing off its depth on offense after 2 blowout wins to open the season
sources.description: The first three pass plays of Miami’s season essentially were the same, with quarterback Darian Mensah connecting with wide receiver Malachi Toney and making it look very easy in the process. It’s exactly what Miami wanted — and exactly what Miami doesn’t want as well.
